Summary:

You will build, activate, and run our partner-first go-to-market engine across India and regional markets (Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka).

This is not a passive alliance or administrative partner role. We need an aggressive, revenue-driven builder who proactively hunts alongside (telcos, distributors, resellers , referral/affiliates , managed services (and/or security) providers, technology - ISVs & Ecosystem alliances)  partners; originates new pipeline, and turns ecosystem relationships into closed revenue. In this role, you cannot wait for the channel to bring inbound leads; you will drive the co-selling cadence, initiate joint territory campaigns, qualify high-value deals and steer deals across the finish line with our direct sales team and partner reps.

Core Technology Focus

• Content Delivery Network (CDN) & Edge Cloud / Compute

• Application Security (Next-Gen WAF, Bot Management, API Security, DDoS Mitigation)

• Edge Observability & Performance

• Emerging Edge & AI Workloads

What You'll Do:

• Build Active Pipeline (Co-Sell & Originate): Drive net-new pipeline creation. Lead proactive account mapping, joint prospecting, and outbound campaigns with partner sales forces rather than relying on inbound partner-delivered leads.

• Recruit & Rationalize Channel Network: Map and onboard high-performing Value-Added Resellers (VARs), National & Global System Integrators (SIs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), Managed Services Providers (MSPs) and regional distributors across India and South Asian markets. You will also onboard technology partners (ISVs and ecosystem alliances) where Fastly could natively integrate to create new routes to market. Additionally, you will oversee activating the channel partnerships led through leading Indian Telcos.

• Execute Joint Business Planning (JBP): Establish clear revenue targets, deal-registration commitments, and measurable go-to-market motions with Tier-1 partners. Align partner leadership with mutual commercial upside.

• Deal Cadence & Field Alignment: Act as the connective tissue between regional direct Account Executives (AEs) and partner sales teams. Manage multi-party deal dynamics, mitigate channel conflict, and compress enterprise sales cycles.

• Enable for Sales Velocity: Work with Solutions Engineering and Partner Enablement to rapidly ramp partner technical pre-sales and field reps to independently identify, position, and advance edge security and compute opportunities.

• Regional Market Execution: Adapt commercial engagement and distribution channels to suit local cross-border dynamics, procurement nuances, and distributor models in Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Nepal alongside high-scale operations in India.

• Operational Rigor: Take end-to-end accountability for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, quarterly forecasting, deal registrations, and CRM data integrity across the region.

What We're Looking For: 

• Sales-Led Ecosystem Mindset: 8+ years of quota-carrying channel sales or partner management experience within enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, CDN, or cybersecurity, with a verifiable track record of beating pipeline and revenue goals.

• Active Co-Selling Instincts: Proven ability to build pipelines from scratch. You know how to motivate partner field reps, run outbound cadences together, and lead high-stakes enterprise deals to closure.

• South Asia Market Depth: Deep existing relationships with key regional distributors, tier-one IT security VARs, and leading System Integrators across India, with hands-on experience navigating business practices in South Asian emerging markets.

• Technical & Commercial Acumen: High conversational fluency in web application architecture, cloud networking, cyber threat vectors, and API security. You can hold your own with Partner CTOs, CISOs, and enterprise architects before handing over to technical specialists.

• Autonomy & Bias for Action: Comfort operating in a fast-evolving regional territory with minimal supervision. You run your region as your own franchise, proactively removing blockers to generate revenue.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

• Established relationships and prior commercial wins with tier-1 Indian telco enterprise divisions

• Proven track record onboarding and monetizing regional two-tier distribution networks across emerging South Asian markets (Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Nepal)

• Hands-on experience structuring bundled managed service offerings with top MSSP SOC teams, embedding edge security and WAF into continuous service contracts

• Prior background executing cloud marketplace transacting models (AWS, GCP, Azure) and co-selling alongside cloud hyper-scalers

• Deep exposure to regional BFSI, high-traffic media/OTT, or hyper-scale e-commerce architectures and procurement frameworks in South Asia

• Experience operationalizing technology integrations and joint GTM motions with leading cybersecurity ISVs, APM platforms, or CI/CD ecosystems

• Technical background or foundational certifications in cloud networking, web performance, or application security frameworks

Work Hours: 

• This position will require you to work during scheduled hours from 9:00AM to 6:00PM IST.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements :

This position is open to Hybrid and Remote Work Locations.

The preferred locations for this position are:

• Bangalore / Mumbai / Chennai / Delhi (Remote)

• Pune (Hybrid)

• Willingness and ability to travel across India and regional markets as needed for partner alignment, customer meetings, and company events. 

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home.  

There is a strong preference for Hybrid near a local office.  However, we may be willing to consider remote candidates within India in the following locations - Bangalore (preferred) / Chennai / Mumbai / Delhi.

This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

A fast-growing AI data company is hiring supply chain practitioners to design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks for evaluating AI agents. You will turn real planning work into end-to-end challenges, each with files, a working solution and an automated correctness check. The goal is to build a benchmark grounded in real operations work.
***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***
Responsibilities
â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning a real supply chain task from your work into a challenge an AI agent solves end to end.
â¢ Define the files, data exports and systems each task runs on, such as ERP, MES and WMS extracts, so the scenario reflects realistic planning conditions.
â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.
â¢ Build the automated check that proves the result is correct, using tests or scripts that accept valid answers and catch planning errors objectively.
â¢ Document the written rules, constraints and SOPs that decide each case, along with realistic edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors from your process.

â¢ Worked inside systems of record (ERP, WMS) and with their exports or reports

â¢ Technical fluency in Python or another language and the command line, plus files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

Nice-to-have

â¢ 5+ years in the same process family
â¢ Docker, Git and experience writing tests

As a Senior Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to both customers and Sales. You’ll lead complex technical evaluations, align solutions to business outcomes, and help shape deal strategy in high-impact opportunities.

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical strategy across your accounts as a peer to the Account Executive - a standing weekly 1:1 with each AE you support, and a standing weekly account team call with the full ecosystem where you carry POV status, technical blockers, and the explanation behind any usage movement.
  • Own the technical explanation behind consumption movement in your accounts. Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.
  • Lead discovery in every meeting, not only in discovery meetings - including meetings where you were invited to present. Leave each meeting knowing something about their business you did not know going in.
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, solution workshops, etc. that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes for diverse stakeholder audiences including executives 
  • Full ownership of the technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining competitive success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify, develop, and leverage technical champions across multi-stakeholder environments, building a structured plan for champion cultivation and influence throughout the deal cycle and beyond
  • Contribute to product direction through active participation in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, bringing field insights and customer patterns to PM and engineering teams
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems 
  • Identify and proactively resolve technical and organizational blockers by collaborating across Product, Support, and GTM teams before customers are impacted
  • Contribute to team enablement by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and creating reusable assets that scale knowledge across the region

Who You Are: 

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at influencing and adapting communication across technical, business, and executive audiences 
  • Advanced background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • Experience displacing or consolidating away from an entrenched incumbent inside an account where that incumbent has internal advocates
  • A consultative, outcome - oriented approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Demonstrated depth over breadth. You have worked a very small number of very large organisations over long horizons, and can describe how your understanding of one account compounded across quarters.
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement initiatives
  • Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it 
  • Growth mindset of embracing change and being curious 
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 Benefits and Growth: 

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks 

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers.
